findings.decision_broken: provenance present but not verifiable against the platform builder identity and OIDC issuer (build L2)
findings.observed: provenance=True, provenance_verified=False, container=api, image=ghcr.io/k8sstormcenter/commons-grid-dynamics-backend:644a0d023d47eaebd3a4ed51f25d8f0d0f7a3433@sha256:93669f4a7650b2c617c7fa825813a1c6b3064251a467e2834952e5dd31ba3f35, verify_note=cosign unavailable: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'cosign'
findings.fix: build on the platform's hosted workflow; the attestation must be signed by its OIDC identity
